title: Snow Removal Subscription Service
description: The City is pleased to announce a snow removal subscription service designed to assist residents with the removal of snow windrows left in front of driveways following plowing operations.

title: Spring Clean-Up April 17-18 at Restricted Use Site
description: The Spearfish Restricted Use Site (RUS), located at 910 Camp Comfort Road, will be waiving fees for residents of the City of Spearfish and Lawrence County on Friday, April 17th through Saturday, April 18th. The RUS will be open from 7:30 AM to 4 PM.

title: Annual cleanup day April 1 at Rose Hill Cemetery
description: The annual cleanup day at Rose Hill Cemetery is Wednesday, April 1, when cemetery staff will be picking up decorations around the monuments in preparation for the summer.

title: Pavement Condition Data Collection Begins March 30, 2026
description: March 30, 2026, Infrastructure Management Services (IMS) will begin collecting data on City roads. A vehicle pulling a small trailer will be slowly travelling up and down City streets mostly between 6 p.m. and 6 a.m. testing the pavement condition.

title: Traffic Signal Outage on E. Colorado Blvd and 27th Street on April 8th, 2026
description: A planned power outage will affect the traffic signals at the intersection of E. Colorado Blvd and 27th St. for several hours starting at 9:00 A.M. on April 8, 2026. The intersection will function as an all-way stop until power is restored.

title: East Colorado Boulevard Widening Project to Resume April 22, 2026
description: Construction to continue April 22, 2026 for the Colorado Boulevard Widening Project. Colorado Boulevard through-traffic will be detoured to Interstate 90 between Exits 14 and 17. Private development work may necessitate road closures as soon as April 14.

title: Public Input for Safety Action Plan Projects
description: Thursday, April 23rd from 5:00 -7:00 p.m. the City will be hosting an Open House for the public to weigh in on prioritizing Safety Action Plan projects for federal funding. A brief presentation on the proposed projects will begin at 5:30 p.m.

title: Recap of Joint City Council/Planning Commission meeting on development standards.
description: Joint Planning Commission and City Council meeting held to discuss streamlining development standards in Spearfish.

title: Know the regulations in place for the spaces you enjoy with your pets, follow all signage
description: Please consider conditions when planning trips, exercise, and daily routines to ensure your pet is safe and comfortable, and follow all animal ordinances designed for the wellbeing of the community.

title: Safety Action Plan Survey
description: Cast your vote for your favorite transportation projects recommended by the city's Safety Action Plan!

title: Reminder: Prevent nuisances by keeping your lawn, trees/shrubs tidy
description: As the seasons change and the growing season kicks into full gear, residents are reminded to maintain their properties, especially yards, trees/shrubs, and sidewalk areas, pursuant to Spearfish City Code.

title: Spearfish Police Department recognizes 2025 employee award recipients
description: Congratulations to Spearfish Police Department 2025 employee honorees: Officer of the Year, School Resource Officer Caleb Frerer; Dispatcher of the Year, Communications Officer Brian Vosburg; and Staff Member of the Year, Criminal Analyst Amber Ball!

title: Spearfish Earns 2025 Tree City USA, Growth Award Recognition From Arbor Day Foundation
description: Spearfish named a 2025 Tree City USA by Arbor Day Foundation in honor of its commitment to plant, grow, and maintain trees to benefit its community. Spearfish received a Growth Award for demonstrating improved levels of tree care and community engagement.

title: Outdoor warning siren test scheduled for May 28
description: The City of Spearfish will be conducting an outdoor warning siren test at 2 p.m. on Thursday, May 28th. In advance of the siren test, the City will also test CivicReady, sending out a notification about the siren test minutes before the siren test begins.

title: E. Colorado Boulevard Sewer Upsize Project to continue May 28, 2026
description: Final phase of E. Colorado Boulevard Sanitary Sewer Upsize Project is expected to begin Thursday, May 28, 2026. Colorado Boulevard will remain open during construction but  travel lanes may be narrowed and speed limits reduced.

title: Speed Limit Reductions on Colorado Boulevard and North Avenue
description: On Tuesday, May 26th, 2026, the City of Spearfish Public Works Department will be permanently decreasing the speed limit from 35 MPH to 25 MPH on sections of North Avenue and East Colorado Boulevard.

title: Reminder: When outdoor warning sirens sound in Spearfish, take cover
description: Outdoor warning sirens are activated for severe weather that may pose an immediate threat to life. When they sound, people should take cover in the safest place available in their immediate vicinity ASAP.

title: Roadway Lane Markings to begin Tuesday, June 16th
description: The City of Spearfish spring application of repainting pavement lane markings will begin Tuesday, June 16th, 2026, weather permitting. The work is expected to take several days to complete.

title: Juneteenth Closures
description: City Hall, Library and Rubble Site will be closed on Friday, June 19th in observance of Juneteenth. Garbage routes will continue to run as scheduled.
